tasks.short: Research chemical effects on tissues or vital processes

existing evidence and approved research constraints
outputs: human-designed study and analysis plan

inputs: human-designed study and analysis plan
actual approved experimental materials and equipment
outputs: actual assay measurements, sample identifiers and observations
actual experimental deviations

inputs: actual assay measurements, sample identifiers and observations
actual experimental deviations
existing approved instrument export fields
outputs: complete actual experiment record draft with source-linked measurements

steps.what: Calculate approved assay summaries and inspect controls, replicates and inconsistent results
inputs: complete actual experiment record draft with source-linked measurements
human-designed study and analysis plan
approved validated calculation methods

steps.what: Interpret the actual chemical-effect evidence and write justified conclusions and limitations
inputs: reproducible assay summaries with flagged uncertainties
actual observations and study limitations

steps.what: Approve the complete experiment record and findings against actual measurements and scientific meaning

complete human-authored findings linked to the experiment record

tasks.design: Configure existing assay-instrument exports {OTHER} into the laboratory notebook {OPS_SYSTEM} and reusable validated summaries in {DATA_PLATFORM}. The scientist still designs and conducts the research, captures actual conditions and interprets the evidence before approving the complete record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated instrument fields and approved calculation setup can add work around experimental research.
tasks.enabler_now: Native laboratory imports and validated analysis templates can reuse actual measurements and sample identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Experimental validity, unexpected effects and causal interpretation require scientific judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist can recognise an apparent effect caused by an experimental artefact rather than the substance.

ambition.what: Review actual assay evidence when another verified experiment is completed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2–5 for laboratory access and method-owner consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: laboratory notebooks can import instrument measurements and analysis tools can reuse validated assay calculations; experimental design and interpretation remain scientific work.

assumptions: Provisional effort shares and savings, not measured laboratory baselines or experimental instructions.
s2 produces actual measurements and observations. s3 retains capture of actual conditions and deviations; only repeated instrument fields change.
Native instrument import and analysis templates first. If an interface is absent, its setup and validation must fit the stated integration budget or the scenario is revised.
No model infers an effect, replaces experiment performance or invents a missing measurement. Same-notebook save has no saving.
research_questions: Which actual data-entry and calculation work remains after native configuration?

already_counted.description: Check complete experiment record and human-authored findings

incremental.description: Maintain instrument mappings and validated calculation templates

approvals.approved_version: approved final experiment record package; edits return to s6

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 3 repeated-instrument-field hours +7.5 calculation hours =10.5. Upkeep 1.5 gives central net 9%; three extra hours resolving instrument/analysis exceptions gives high 6%. Low zero where native features are already used.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.design: Configure approved isotope-analysis instrument metadata {OTHER} into the laboratory notebook {OPS_SYSTEM} and reuse validated calculation templates in {DATA_PLATFORM}. The scientist conducts the actual tracer research and interprets cellular transformations, with raw-data and assumption checks before the completed record is saved.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated sample/time metadata entry and validated calculation setup can add effort around actual isotope research.
tasks.enabler_now: Native analytical exports and reusable calculation templates can preserve links from raw measurement to summary.
tasks.still_hard: Tracer assumptions, incomplete recovery and whether the evidence supports a transformation pathway require scientific judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist recognises when a numerical time course does not justify the proposed cellular mechanism.

ambition.what: Recompute the approved analysis when another actual tracer dataset is checked.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2–5 for authorised laboratory access and method-owner review

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: analytical instrument exports and validated scientific calculation templates can reuse measured isotope data with sample and time provenance.

assumptions: Provisional work-design arithmetic, not a measured isotope-research baseline or a laboratory procedure.
Actual measurements and needed correction inputs are produced by authorised experimental work in s2; missing inputs remain missing rather than being generated.
s3 retains actual condition and deviation capture. Only repeated metadata entry and calculation setup change.
Native import and validated analysis functions first. No autonomous experiment changes or pathway conclusions are proposed.
Same-notebook save has no saving. Overlap with broader substance-effects research must be reconciled in a role roll-up.
research_questions: Which sample metadata and calculations can repeat without changing scientific assumptions?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 2 repeated-metadata hours +6 calculation hours =8. One upkeep hour gives central net 7%; three extra hours checking correction inputs gives high 4%. Low zero if existing native analysis already covers these steps.

tasks.design: Configure existing assay equipment exports {OTHER} into the laboratory system {OPS_SYSTEM} and reusable validated performance summaries in {DATA_PLATFORM}. The scientist develops or executes the actual test and evaluates its evidence; a populated summary does not diagnose a patient or release a test for clinical use.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated test metadata and calculation setup can add work around assay development and evaluation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native laboratory imports and validated analysis templates can carry actual test and control data into reproducible summaries.
tasks.still_hard: Intended use, control validity and whether validation supports a detection claim require scientific judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist can reject a seemingly strong aggregate result when the evidence does not support the intended use.

ambition.what: Review test-performance evidence when another authorised validation run is completed.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: laboratory systems can import actual assay outputs and validated analysis templates can calculate test-performance summaries, with human evaluation of intended-use evidence.

assumptions: Provisional shares and savings, not measured diagnostic-test baselines or clinical advice.
Actual test and control measurements are produced in s3; s4 retains capture of actual execution, deviations and source checks.
Native import and validated calculation features first. No model infers missing results or makes a patient diagnosis.
Saving the study record does not authorise a clinical test or replace any required independent scientific and quality review.
Same-system save has no saving. Developing a new assay and executing an existing one have different effort mixes; this scenario must be refit to the chosen variant.

tasks.design: Configure actual candidate data from analytical equipment {OTHER} into the laboratory system {OPS_SYSTEM}, with validated summaries in {DATA_PLATFORM}. Reuse a report template in {DOCS}; the scientist retains candidate choice, experimental work and actual development conclusions before approving the complete record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated measurement fields, established calculations and development-report formatting can add work around candidate research.
tasks.enabler_now: Native laboratory imports and report templates can reuse actual experiment records and validated summary outputs.
tasks.still_hard: Candidate suitability, scientific uncertainty and whether evidence justifies further development require accountable scientific decisions.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist recognises when an attractive summary conceals weak evidence or a failed experimental assumption.

ambition.what: Review a candidate's actual research evidence after another authorised experiment.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2–5 for confidential candidate data and scientific/quality-owner review

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: laboratory systems can link candidate test data to validated summaries and populate development-report templates while scientists retain conclusions.

assumptions: Provisional effort shares and savings, not measured drug-development baselines or a prediction of scientific success.
Actual candidate measurements are produced in s3 and captured in s4. No model invents compounds, evidence, efficacy or safety claims.
s5 retains four hours per 100 for calculation checking, and separate s5b retains five hours for actual scientific evaluation and conclusion authoring; only established calculation setup is reduced.
Native functions first. This is authorised research, not commercial release, regulatory approval or prescribing; no autonomous release action is hidden in the design.
Same-workspace save has no saving. Reconcile overlap with broader chemical-effects research and test-development tasks before role aggregation.
unknowns: Actual mix of development judgement and repeat calculations
research_questions: Which fixed preparation steps remain after native laboratory configuration?

incremental.description: Maintain instrument mappings, validated summaries and report templates

approvals.approved_version: approved final candidate-development record package; edits return to s7

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 3 repeated-instrument-field hours +6 fixed-calculation hours +4 report-assembly hours =13. Two upkeep hours give central net 11%; four extra hours resolving candidate-data inconsistencies gives high 7%. Low zero if native features are already used or review absorbs the preparation reduction.
